name: Esme World UI kit
scale: Draw at 1x. Show at whole-number scales only: 3x desktop, 2x phone. CSS: image-rendering: pixelated.
nine_slice: slice = [top, right, bottom, left] in 1x pixels (CSS border-image-slice order). border-width = slice * scale.
note: The ui/parchment ramp is a proposed palette addition (sampled to match the Stardew menu look). Everything else uses the Esme World pack palette by name.

panel.use: Big menu panel. border-image slice 6 7 6 6 (top right bottom left), stretch; fill with the parchment gradient parch2->parch4 top to bottom.

inset.use: Sunken box inside a panel (groups, list rows).

row.use: Clickable list row (store items, journal goals). Hover: row-hover.

divider.use: Horizontal band that splits a panel in two (inventory/equipment). Stretch horizontally.

tab.use: Top tab, 18x18, icon 12x12 centred at (3,3). Bottom edge hides under the panel's top border (overlap 4px).

tab-active.use: Selected tab: lighter face, drawn 3px lower so it bites into the panel.

tab-side.use: Side tab (open edge faces right, toward the panel). Icon at (3,2).

slot.use: Inventory / hotbar slot 16x16; item 16x16 drawn on top. Slots tile with no gap.

slot-lg.use: 20x20 sticker-book slot: a 16x16 sticker sits dead centre with 2px all round.

slot-selected.use: Red selection square drawn over a slot at offset (-1,-1).

tooltip.use: Hover/tap card. Fill parch2. Add a 3px hard drop shadow (rgba(0,0,0,.35)) down-right.

tooltip-divider.use: Band between tooltip title block and body. Stretch horizontally, spans inner width.

dialogue-box.use: Dialogue text box: wooden poles with nailed corners, parchment fill. Text inset 10px. Also wraps the portrait panel.

wood-planks.use: Tileable plank fill (background-repeat) behind the portrait.

name-scroll.use: Name label under the portrait and title tabs (e.g. 'Sticker Book'). 3-slice: 7px caps, middle repeats.

btn-close.use: Close (X) button, top-right outside the panel corner.

btn-arrow-right.use: Cycle arrow (wardrobe, pages). Hover: brighten (filter: brightness(1.12)) and nudge 1px.

btn-text.use: Orange word button (Place, Wear, Buy). Text in parch0 with ui_or4 shadow.

frame-thin.use: Thin frame: hotbar, pickup toast, small boxes.

hud-box.use: Sunken text box inside HUD panels.

letter-paper.use: Letter / kind note paper. Fill parch0; text in the dialogue font, colour text.

board.use: Wooden board behind the calendar and the noticeboard. Plank fill repeats.

badge-new.use: 'NEW' tag on journal goals and freshly earned stickers.

emote-bang.use: '!' bubble over something new on the farm or a sticker waiting to be placed. Bob 1px.

place-target.use: Tile brackets around a sticker's home spot while placing. Pulse opacity / 1px in-out.

dialogue-next.use: Bobbing 'more' marker at the dialogue box's bottom-right.

hud-clock.use: Top-right HUD. Text drawn in the small font into the regions; icons 12x7 into the three icon boxes.

hud-journal.use: Hangs under the HUD bar when a new goal arrives.

icon-frame.use: Framed picture square (milestone card corners, skill-style icons). 16x16 art fits at (2,2).

btn-help.use: '?' help button, top-right of every screen (left of the X). Opens the host friend's guide.

icon-noticeboard.use: Noticeboard (farm notes: bundles, the stuck task, requests, tips).

ribbon-bow.use: Tied ribbon on a door or gate that's waiting (the stuck task).

sign-post.use: Little sign beside a waiting door: 'See the noticeboard'.

bunting.use: Holiday bunting strip (tile horizontally) for festival decorations.

icon-streak.use: Streak counter flame (days in a row). Never shown red or 'broken'.

icon-tick.use: Ticked-off task in the day's tally.
